capabilities.description: Checks for unread Surichat messages and sends due email reminders.

fields.label: Enable reminders
fields.description: Turn on email reminders for unread chat messages.

fields.label: Support email
fields.description: Email address that receives alerts for messages from users.

fields.label: SMTP host
fields.description: Hostname of your outgoing mail server, such as smtp.example.com.

fields.label: SMTP port (587, 465)
fields.description: Use 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for direct TLS. Leave blank to use 587.

fields.label: From address
fields.description: Sender email address authorized by your mail provider.

fields.label: SMTP username
fields.description: SMTP login name. Leave blank if your server does not require authentication.

fields.label: SMTP password
fields.description: SMTP password or app password, if your mail provider requires one.

fields.label: Public Silo URL
fields.description: Public address of your Silo home page, used by the email sign-in button.

fields.label: First reminder delay (minutes)
fields.description: Minutes an unread message must wait before the first email. Default: 10.

fields.label: Second reminder delay after first (hours)
fields.description: Hours to wait after the first attempt before a second email, if still unread. Default: 4.

presentation.summary: Private support chat for Silo users and administrators.
presentation.description_markdown:
![Surichat](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deejayexe/silo-plugin-suricata/main/plugins/surichat/brand/surichat.png)

Private support chat with an administrator inbox, unread counts, and optional email reminders. Messages and read status are stored in an SQLite file on your server. The web interface is available in English and Spanish.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Install Surichat from the Suricata catalog. Open Surichat from Silo Web.
2. Set an absolute path on a writable, persistent volume for the SQLite database.
3. Configure the internal Silo URL and a dedicated administrator API key with the monitor-read scope to list user accounts.
4. Optionally enable email reminders and configure SMTP, the support mailbox, and your public Silo URL. If moving from an existing Surichat installation, follow the migration guide before enabling reminders.
